line: A first strike, petitioner. It will be minuted.
Do try to bleed on the correct side. The carpet is new.
Guard, did you see that? Say you saw that.

situation: She lands a hit, her guard watching
line: Applaud, guard. Quietly. We are working.
Hold still. We are trying to be gracious.
Missed. We shall call it a rehearsal.
Hiding behind your arms. How very junior.
Come out, petitioner. We have a schedule.
Running laps? The empire does not do laps. It does parades.
How eager. We love an eager petitioner. It makes the filing shorter.
Charge by all means. We will wait. We are very good at waiting. We are better at forms.

situation: A long stretch of the fight
line: We are being very patient. Make a note of it, guard.
This is what we call a state visit.
Smile, petitioner. The portrait is being drawn.
Behind us, as ever. Where a guard belongs.
Fix that, will you? You always say you will.
Sulk later. We are busy.
Not a bite, petitioner. We are not that sort of empire.

situation: A crater opens under the opponent
line: A pit! How municipal.
Oh, that was due for demolition. We simply sped up the paperwork.
You are swaying. It is a nice sway. Do hold it.

situation: The opponent is on the brink
line: Nearly done, petitioner. Do not spoil it by getting up.
Make way. The empire is overtaking.

situation: A hit lands on her head
line: Mind the crown!

situation: She has just won a long exchange
line: That one goes on the record.
Hm. We are bored. Do something terrible.

situation: A hit lands on the opponent's chest
line: An unhappy sound, that. File it under: You.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'Whatever you're planning, I'll stop it.'
line: Stop it, petitioner? We have not yet submitted it.
How rude. We were being thorough.

situation: He said (Anti-hero): 'You were loud. That was all you were.'
line: Loud? We are the loudest empire on file.
Filth! How dare you. ...Say it again. We enjoyed it.

situation: He said (Cyborg): 'Would you care for a menu?'
line: We would care for a manager. Fetch one.
We do not sit. We are seated.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'Nobody's on the menu today.'
line: Then who is the main course? We insist on a main course.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'Is that all you've got?'
line: All we have? Petitioner, we have an empire.

situation: He said (Anti-hero): 'Do take that cape off.'
line: Take it off! It is the train! It is the one thing we have not annexed.
They are on parade. Parade is tiring.
It is Revision Four. It is a revision with a hat.

situation: She said (Empress, mirror): 'Revision Four. We have added a hat.'
line: We have added two. Look closer, copy.

situation: The opponent calls her a coward for hiding behind her guard
line: A coward! We are royalty. We delegate.
Say that again. We will have it minuted.
How rude. Revision Five is offended, and will say so in writing.
Ohoho. Cute. Cute! ...Filed under Cute.
The hat is on file. The hat is lovelier than you.
You mock the hat? The hat has a legal standing.

situation: The opponent laughs at her paperwork
line: Laugh! The paperwork will be laughing at you later.
Talk is how we conquer. The rest is administration.

situation: The opponent says her guard is useless
line: The guard is ornamental. Do not insult the ornament.
You struck us! Do you know what revision this is? ...You struck ME.
That is the last time you do that in this revision!
We were speaking! We are ALWAYS speaking!

situation: A taunt, smooths her train over one arm, 1 second
line: Petitioner, you are boring us.

situation: A taunt, smooths her train, 1 second
line: We have seen better. We have commissioned better.

situation: A taunt, smooths her train, 1 second
line: How quaint.

situation: A taunt, smooths her train, 1 second
line: Do carry on. It is nearly amusing.

situation: A taunt, tilts her chin, 1 second (vs Protagonist)
line: Do not look so brave. It crumples the file.

situation: A taunt, tilts her chin, 1 second (vs Anti-hero)
line: A hierarchy, petitioner. You may wait at the bottom.

situation: A taunt, tilts her chin, 1 second (vs Cyborg)
line: Petitioner, we do not eat with the staff.

situation: A taunt, smooths her train, 1 second
line: We have a cold, a train, and an empire. Pick which to fear.

situation: Encore, from out of reach (vs Protagonist)
line: Go on, petitioner. Break through them. We shall be over here, being unreachable.

situation: Encore, from out of reach (vs Protagonist)
line: Every second you spend on them is a second the empire enjoys.

situation: Encore, from out of reach (vs Anti-hero)
line: Do hurry, petitioner. Ours is a very long parade.

situation: Encore, from out of reach (vs Anti-hero)
line: You wanted a hierarchy. Here it is. You are at the bottom.

situation: Encore, from out of reach (vs Cyborg)
line: Have a snack, petitioner. My guard is on the menu, we hear.

situation: Encore, from out of reach (vs Cyborg)
line: Please take a number. We are busy. We are at a distance.
Is this the fourth revision? The third? ...There will be a form.
Form 9-B. Where is 9-B? ...Later.
The guard will see to the crowd. We rest. We are resting.
That will leave a mark on the record.
We are not afraid. We are... annoyed. It is a different form.

situation: The opponent is a good fighter
line: Hm. A genuine petitioner. How tedious.
There goes the aide. He was getting good at sighing.

situation: She is pushed to the brink
line: Do not scream. Do not scream. ...Scream a little.
He still thinks he can talk. Cute.
That one is a grievance in boots.
He keeps staring at the Runner. The Runner is nervous. Rightly.
Four, five, nine-B. A mountain of paperwork. We will deal with it.
Not like this. Not in front of the guard.
What is the use of an empire if it cannot watch a fight?

situation: She is hit in the face
line: Mind the face! It is the one we have on file!
You struck us! Do you know what revision this is?
That is a tort, petitioner.
Ow! ...The empire does not say ow. The empire says: noted.
A scratch. We shall have it framed.
Do you know what that cost to print?
You struck ME. ...Us. You struck US.
You will answer for this in triplicate!
Guard! Guard! Where is my guard?
I am... we are... the empire is a little unwell.
This is not on the schedule!
Enough! Enough, enough, enough!

situation: A hit knocks off her hat or train fragment
line: The hat! That was custom!
You struck us mid-sentence!
How DARE you. ...We dare.

situation: A hit lands on the aide, her guard
line: Not the aide! He has the stationery!

situation: Her guard member is knocked down
line: Guard, rise. It is a rank thing.

situation: Encore: the guard falls and she is within reach
line: You... you defeated my guard. Nobody defeats my guard! ...We will do it ourselves.
Very well. Now we come to the part with us in it.
Annexing. The empire thanks you for your patronage.
Look at that skyline, guard. Now it is a better skyline.
One does like a blank province.
Reassigning the deeds. Nobody was using them. They were screaming, but nobody was using them.
The train looks marvellous against the rubble.
A village. How rustic. How vacant.
We shall name it after us. When we find the paperwork.
Oh, that was due for demolition. We simply sped up the paperwork.
Shoo. Do not trample the carpet.
The petitioners flee. How orderly. How adorable.
Where did everyone go? ...Wonderful. It is a private audience.
Nobody to annex. And nobody to complain to. How dull.
A private room. How very irregular. Guard, note the room.
Hurry, petitioner. We have other provinces.
Take your time. We will use it to compose our complaint.
A glow. How seasonal.
Be quick. You make the parade look slow.
Take your moment. We will not watch. We will minute it.
A new sulk! How we love the premiere.
Update, petitioner? We have seen a software update. It was a hat.
Do restructure. We shall wait. We are a sovereign power.
Under new management? We hope the new management has a title.
Revision? We have filed that one. Under: Copy.
Revision Four. We have added a hat. Do not ask what that will cost us in paperwork.
Revision Nine: Field Revision. Armour. The covering letter alone is forty pages.
Revision Twelve. And every one of you will be sorry, once we have finished the filing.
There. A new likeness. Somebody will have to certify it. It will be us. It is always us.
Revision Two. Louder. That is the entire update.
...Guard, hold my train. We are about to ruin a perfectly good filing.
A revision. Now. In the middle of a fight. The forms alone.
Nine-B. Nine-C. Where is nine-C?
Again? From the top.
Approved. Retain your copy.
Do you have any idea how much paperwork this is? ...Never mind. Hold still.
We will deal with the forms later. We will deal with the forms for a month.
Decree Line!
Decree!
By decree. Decree Line!
The Last Word!
Case closed. Please retain your copy.
A small matter, petitioner. It is merely paperwork.
We shall have you framed. In triplicate.
Sign here, petitioner. Do not worry. It is a short form.
Be dismissed. With honour. We are generous.
Take your complaint to the department of Outcomes.
Still here? How very inconvenient.

situation: She is blocked at the last moment
line: Blocked! That is not in the appendix!

situation: She wins with her guard watching
line: Guard, present arms. The petitioner has been processed.
How quaint. It did not tickle.
Is that the entire submission?
Three! We have received three and we have enjoyed none.

situation: Entrance, her guard lines up behind her
line: Guard, present arms. We are visiting.

situation: Entrance, the aide checks a wristwatch
line: Do not look at the watch. We are early.
Petitioner. We have a long list. You are at the bottom of it.
Petitioner. You wished for a rival. We are a hierarchy.
Petitioner. We are informed you are on a diet. We approve of the diet.
Begin, petitioner. We have forms.
Which of us is the original? Guard, check the record.
Present arms! ...Smartly, you.

situation: The Encore recall call, she climbs to a balcony of air
line: Guard! ENCORE! Present arms, and try to look expensive.
The empire calls an encore! All of you, back on parade!
Nobody dismissed you. We merely took an early lunch. ENCORE!
Guard, return. We have re-read your dismissal. It was a clerical error.
Curtain up, guard! Once more, with feeling!

situation: Her free last signature is ready at the brink
line: We are not amused.

situation: Her free last signature is ready, alternate
line: This is your last warning, petitioner.

situation: Her free last signature is ready, alternate
line: We are NOT finished.
Revision Twelve, Approved. Sign here. We do not accept cheques.
A small matter, petitioner. It is merely paperwork.
Case closed. Please retain your copy.
Guard, present arms. The petitioner has been processed.
We shall have you framed. In triplicate.
Applause, guard. Moderate. We are not vulgar.
We take your promise to fix things under advisement. Refused.
You wished to be feared. We filed it under Unfulfilled.
Your manager will receive our regards. It will be an extremely short letter.

situation: She wins with the aide pained
line: Ma'am, the paperwork for a win alone... We will deal with it later.

situation: Encore: the guard holds and she steps back in
line: Well done, guard. Dismissed... no. Stay. We are stepping in.
We are back, petitioner. Did you miss us? Do not answer.
This is an unapproved outcome! We appeal. ...I APPEAL.
We reject this ruling. We reject it in writing.
Wrong department! This should have gone to Outcomes!
Guard! Fetch the other outcomes. The ones where we win.
We will lodge a complaint. With ourselves. We will uphold it.
I... we... no. I appeal. I appeal this.
You will fix the planet. You said you would. Do.
We hold you in very low esteem, and a great deal of paperwork.
